embeddings.title: Kugadzirira magwaro ako
embeddings.description: Kunongedza mafaera akabatanidzwa kuti akwanise kutsvaga nekutaurwa. Izvi zvinogona kutora chinguva kune magwaro makuru.

creation.musicLyricsGuide: Rondedzera chimiro uye izwi muchikumbiro chako. Isa mazwi pasi pema tags pazasi. Dzima {{instrumental}} pamazwi.
creation.setupStorage: Mafaira ese: {{download}}. Reserve: {{reserve}}. Imwe nzvimbo inodiwa: {{required}}. Yemahara padhiraivha yakasarudzwa: {{free}}.
creation.setupSpaceMissing: Hapana {{missing}}. Sunungura nzvimbo kana sarudza imwe dhiraivha ine chengetedzo yakakwana.
creation.setupTextNote: Mavara-chete imwe nzira yekukurukurirana, kunyora, maturusi nemhinduro dzakarongwa. Dhaunirodha: ingangoita {{size}}. Inoda ndangariro yakawanda kupfuura {{defaultModel}} uye haigadzirise mifananidzo kana audio pachayo. Mhinduro dzekutaura dzinoshandisa izwi rehurongwa. Sarudza iyo yezvinyorwa zvebasa kana uine ndangariro yakakwana. Tarisa mhinduro dzechokwadi nemanyuko.
creation.setupImageNote: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Q4_K_M inogadzira mifananidzo; Qwen3 inoisa tsananguro uye VAE inoburitsa mufananidzo wekupedzisira. Gadzirisa chimiro chechiyero, kugadzirisa, mbeu, nhanho uye upscaling. Kurudziro yekutanga: 21:9, matanho mana nembeu isina kurongeka.
creation.setupMusicNote: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo inogadzira mimhanzi yezviridzwa kana nziyo. Murongi anovaka chimiro; iyo 2B Q4_K_M jenareta inogadzira, mavara encoder anobata tsananguro uye VAE inodhidha stereo 48 kHz audio. Gadzirisa nguva, odhiyo fomati, tempo, mazwi, mutauro, matanho uye mbeu. Zvinokurudzirwa: 30 masekonzi, nhanho sere, WAV 24-bit uye mbeu isina kurongeka.
creation.setupVideoNote: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B Q4_K_M inogadzira zvikamu kubva pane tsananguro. Inokurudzirwa: masekonzi mashanu, 21:9 uye 16 FPS. Gadzirisa nguva, furemu chiyero, kugadzirisa, matanho uye mbeu. Zvinangwa zvenguva refu zvinounganidza zvipfupi zvipfupi; kucheka kunooneka kunogoneka. MP4: Python + mufananidzoio-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: Dhawunirodha uye gadzirisa iwo anokurudzirwa modhi: LFM3-Omni + mmproj zvemavara, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 yekutsvagisa mitauro yakawanda (CPU by default), FLUX.2 Klein 4B uye zvikamu zvayo zvekugadzira mifananidzo, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×4, ACE-Step yemimhanzi (Instrumental on by default), uye Wan2.1 zvevhidhiyo. Tarisa saizi yemafaira, disk nzvimbo uye vhidhiyo prerequisites pazasi. Kuparura kurodha uye Bhurawuza inoramba iripo.
creation.videoDurationNote: Mavhidhiyo marefu anounganidzwa kubva kumapfupi mapfupi. Kuchekwa kunogona kuoneka uye chizvarwa chinogona kutora nguva yakareba.
creation.configure: Sarudza modhi yegore ine API kiyi, kana gadzirisa injini yemuno yakasarudzwa uye mafaera ayo anodiwa mumagadzirirwo eKugadzira.
creation.localNote: Mifananidzo yemuno inoshandisa yakazara Diffusers folda, yakaparadzana GGUF/Safetensors zvikamu zvine stable-diffusion.cpp, kana inotsigirwa NVFP4 CUDA uremu nePython. Vhidhiyo inoshandisa Diffusers. Sarudzo dzeCPU/GPU dzakaparadzana kune encoder uye jenareta yemifananidzo mune enjini-yakavakirwa injini.
creation.autosave: Mifananidzo nemavhidhiyo anenge apedzwa anochengetwa otomatiki mumafolda akaparadzana Novera mukati mehurongwa hweMapikicha neVhidhiyo maforodha, aine magadzirirwo echizvarwa.
creation.autoNote: Otomatiki inoona zviri pachena zvikumbiro zvekugadzira mifananidzo kana vhidhiyo muFrench neChirungu. Iwe unogona kugara uchisarudza iyo yekubuda fomati iwe pachako.
creation.variantPrompt: Gadzira shanduro itsva yemufananidzo uyu, uchichengeta musoro wayo mukuru.
creation.missing: Chigadzirwa ichi chakafambiswa kana kuti hachawanikwe pakombuta iyi.
creation.desktopOnly: Kugadzira mufananidzo uye vhidhiyo ine otomatiki kuchengetedza inowanikwa mudesktop application.
creation.inputUnsupported: Shandisa mufananidzo mumwe unotsigirwa nemhando yakasarudzwa. Kupinza mavhidhiyo uye mifananidzo yakawanda haishandiswe pano.
creation.animatePrompt: Ratidza mufananidzo uyu uchichengetedza chinyorwa chayo chikuru.
creation.filterNote: Mufananidzo uye Vhidhiyo kusefa iyo yakagadzirwa. Multimodal modhi inogona kunzwisisa akati wandei marudzi ekuisa; izvi hazvirevi nguva dzose kuti vanogona kugadzira mifananidzo kana vhidhiyo.
creation.generationOnly: Iyi modhi inogadzira midhiya. Sarudza iyo muchikamu cheMufananidzo kana Vhidhiyo.
creation.cloudNote: Cloud generation inotumira yako yekukurumidza uye yekuisa mufananidzo kune akasarudzwa mupi uye anogona kuunza mhosva. Kumira munharaunda hakugone kukanzura kubhadharisa kure.
creation.cloudDefaults: Cloud inoshandisa mupi-chaiwo preset. Maparamendi emunharaunda anoshanda kune yakasarudzwa yenzvimbo yekugadzira injini.
creation.cloudTimeout: Basa regore harina kupera mukati menguva yakatarwa. Tarisa mamiriro ayo nemupi usati watanga chimwe chizvarwa chinobhadharwa.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly inoda tokeni yekuwana uye x-api-kiyi yekiyi yemutengi muzvirongwa zvevapi.
creation.catalogNote: Uyu mupi anoshandisa yakachengetwa modhi runyorwa. Kuizorodza hakubvumidze kiyi kana account yako kuwana. Hapana chizvarwa chakabhadharwa chinoshandiswa kuyedza zvitupa.
creation.ggufNote: Sarudza iyo diffusion modhi, zvinyorwa encoder uye VAE zvakasiyana. Kune FLUX.2 Klein 4B, shandisa Qwen3-4B encoder inoenderana, kusanganisira yayo GGUF akasiyana. Inotsigirwa NVFP4 mafaera anogadzirirwa kamwe chete nePython uye PyTorch mune yakakura inoenderana cache; zvepakutanga zvinogara zvisina kushanduka. Izvi zvinoda imwe dhisiki nzvimbo uye RAM. PaWindows, Novera inosanganisira uye inogadzirisa injini otomatiki. Auto inoshandisa hardware inowanikwa; CUDA inoda CUDA kuvaka. Distilled Klein inowanzoshandisa 4 matanho uye CFG 1. Hapana uremu hunotorwa.
creation.ggufWrongModel: Iyi GGUF ine mavara encoder. Sarudza iyo mundima ye encoder uye sarudza yakaparadzana diffusion modhi mundima yemufananidzo.
creation.nativeNote: Native NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Comfy weights, Qwen3-4B GGUF encoder uye FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. Inoda Blackwell (RTX 50 akatevedzana kana inoenderana), Python, CUDA PyTorch uye inosarudzika NVFP4 kutsamira. Zvinyorwa-ku-mufananidzo chete. Hardware isina kutsigirwa inokundikana zvakajeka; sarudza stable-diffusion.cpp kuti ienderane. Hapana BF16 diffusion cache.
creation.deviceNote: Izvi zvikamu zvine sarudzo dzakazvimirira dzemidziyo. Auto inoshandisa hardware inowanikwa; NVFP4 inogara ichida inofambirana neGPU pakugadzira uye inoshandisa GPU encoding yemavara kana VRAM inokwana. Qwen paCPU inogona kusevha VRAM asi inononoka kukodha. Qwen paGPU inoshandisa layer offload. In stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto inotevera injini yakasarudzwa; kumanikidza CUDA kunoda CUDA kuvaka.
creation.totalTimeHint: Yese nguva inosanganisira kurodha, mameseji encoding, chizvarwa, chero gore rakamirira, kurodha uye kuchengetedza. Chizvarwa chega chinoratidzwa zvakasiyana kana injini ichichizivisa.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: GPU chizvarwa, Qwen3-4B encoding paCPU, 4 nhanho, CFG 1. Yakaedzwa paWindows neVulkan; kumhanya uye kuenderana zvinoenderana nehardware yako.
creation.seedNote: Mifananidzo yemuno chete. Enzanisa nemhando imwechete uye marongero.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Kugadziriswa kukuru mu Novera: 2048 × 2048 px. Kuyeuka kwakakwana kunodiwa.
creation.upscaleNote: Mushure mechizvarwa. Inoda Python/PyTorch. Maximum goho: × 2 4096 × 4096, × 4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Gadzirira uye simbisa zvinodiwa zvemunharaunda mu Novera · Magadzirirwo.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Kuchinja reshiyo kunogadzirisa kugadzirisa kwazvino. Zviyero zvinoshandisa akawanda e 16, kusvika 2048 px.
creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: Sarudzo NVFP4 uremu hwe NVIDIA Blackwell GPU kana hutsva huine 4.5 GiB yeVRAM. Kuti ushandise uremu uhwu muNovera, modhi yakazara inochengeterwa inofanira kutanga yashandurwa kuita NVFP4 GGUF inoenderana} uye yoitwa. Shanduko iyi haisati yasimbiswa panzvimbo ino yekutarisa. Iyo Safetensors yakabatana faira haigone kukwidzwa zvakananga neinjini yakavakirwa mukati. Q8_0 inoramba iri kurudziro yakagadzirira kushandisa. Zvido zvendangariro zvinoenderanawo nekureba kwechirevo.
creation.setupOmniNote: Default pane desktop uye mobile. Mutevedzeri wakakwana wemavara, mifananidzo neodhiyo, uchishandisa inodiwa {{projector}} faira. Dhaunirodha: ingangoita {{size}} yemafaira ese ari maviri. Sarudza iyo yekureruka multimodal setup. Zvimiro zvezwi zvinoenderana nepuratifomu uye injini. Chimiro chakareba chinoshandisa ndangariro yakawanda.

creationInstall.confirm: Dhaunirodha mafaera aya kune iyi folda? Marezinesi evanopa anoshanda.
creationInstall.background: Unogona kuramba uchikurukura uye kugadzira mifananidzo kana mavhidhiyo panguva yekurodha. Tevera kufambira mberi uchishandisa main-bar icon.
creationInstall.engine: Injini yakavakirwa-mukati: otomatiki CUDA / Vulkan / CPU
creationInstall.note: GPU chizvarwa, Qwen3-4B encoding paCPU, 4 nhanho, CFG 1. Yakaedzwa paWindows neVulkan; kumhanya uye kuenderana zvinoenderana nehardware yako.
creationInstall.error: Kuisa kwakundikana. Tarisa network yako, nzvimbo yemahara, kodzero dzekuwana uye marezinesi emhando, wobva watangazve.

memory.title: Yenzvimbo modhi ndangariro
memory.autoNote: Inotakura modhi painodiwa uye inoburitsa isingashandiswe modhi mushure mekuita basa rapera.
memory.manualNote: Mameseji, mufananidzo nevhidhiyo zvinogona kushanda pamwe chete muhurukuro dzakasiyana kana RAM/VRAM zvibvumira. Mienzaniso inogona kupera mundangariro.
memory.preserve: Mafaira uye hurukuro zvinochengetwa; modhi reload pazvinenge zvichidiwa. Shanduko dzinoshanda kune zvitsva zvikumbiro.
memory.failed: Memory optimization yatadza. Edza zvakare kana sarudza Manual.

sharing.imageHint: Shanduko yemifananidzo inoshandisa chimiro chichiri. SVG inobatidza mufananidzo weraster; ICO inongogumira ku 256 px.
sharing.videoHint: Shandisa HTML kana ZIP kuchengeta mavhidhiyo achitamba uye mafaira epakutanga.
sharing.fallback: System yekugovana haisipo pano pafomati iyi. Sevha kana kudhinda faira.
sharing.tooLarge: Kutengeswa kunze kwakakurisa. Sarudza zvinhu zvishoma kana kugovera zvepakutanga media.
sharing.failed: Haikwanisi kupedzisa kutumira kunze kana kugovera. Tarisa mafaera uye edza imwe fomati.
sharing.localHint: Ongorora izvo zvakasarudzwa usati wagovera. Hapana chinongedzo cheruzhinji chinogadzirwa.
sharing.linuxHint: Linux inovhura email yako application nechinamatira. Hapana chinotumirwa otomatiki.

instructions.textDefault: Uri Novera. Pindura zvakajeka, nemazvo uye muchidimbu mumutauro wemushandisi. Tevedzera zvinovamanikidza, simbisa chokwadi chakakosha kana zvichibvira uye taura kusagadzikana. Usafe wakagadzira masosi, mhedzisiro kana zviito zvakapedzwa.
instructions.imageDefault: Tevedzera chinyorwa chakakumbirwa, chimiro uye furemu. Shandisa kuumbwa kwakajeka, kupenya kwakabatana uye ruzivo rwakanaka. Chengetedza mazita ekuzivikanwa; dzivisa kukanganisa uye zvinhu zvisingadiwi. Isa mavara chete kana wakumbirwa.
instructions.videoDefault: Tevedza chinyorwa chakakumbirwa, chimiro uye nguva. Chengetedza zvidzidzo, zvinhu uye chiedza chakafanana pamafuremu. Shandisa yakatsetseka inofamba uye inodzorwa kamera basa. Dzivisa flicker, kukanganisa uye zvinyorwa zvisina kukumbirwa.
